title: aigopath_viewer
description: How the viewer treats the inputs and outputs of one EMPAIA app. The EAD stays the source of truth for structure: the type of every input and output, which input a value is bound to (`reference`), the allowed classes and the class colours (`rendering`). This config never repeats those; it only adds viewer behaviour on top, keyed by the same `io` keys as the EAD.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Gives editors autocompletion and validation while writing the config.

version.description: Syntax version. Must be `2`. A config without `version` is read as the old syntax and upgraded automatically.

defaults.description: Settings shared by every input or output of one EAD type.

inputs.description: Settings per input, keyed by EAD `io` key.

outputs.description: Settings per output, keyed by EAD `io` key. The order of the keys is the order of the layers: the first key is the bottom layer. Outputs that are not listed come after the listed ones.

modes.description: Overrides that apply to one EAD job mode only. Everything outside `modes` applies to all modes.

standalone.description: Overrides for jobs the user starts from the viewer.

preprocessing.description: Overrides for jobs that run automatically on a new slide.

postprocessing.description: Overrides for jobs that run after other jobs.

modeOverride.title: Mode override
modeOverride.description: Same three blocks as the top level, applied to one job mode.

defaults.title: Type defaults
defaults.description: Settings keyed by EAD type name, for example `float`, `rectangle` or `continuous_pixelmap`. The kind block must be the one that belongs to that type.

inputs.description: Settings for every input of an EAD type.

outputs.description: Settings for every output of an EAD type.

inputEntry.title: Input entry
inputEntry.description: One input. Holds the common fields and exactly one kind block. Which kind block is allowed is decided by the EAD type of this key. For a `collection` input the entry describes the items of the collection.

label.description: Name shown to the user instead of the `io` key.

description.description: Help text shown under the field. Replaces the EAD description.

inputEntry.x-oneOfMessage: must contain exactly one kind block: number, string, bool, annotation, wsi, pixelmap or class

inputDefault.title: Input type default
inputDefault.description: Exactly one kind block, without `label` or `description`.
inputDefault.x-oneOfMessage: must contain exactly one kind block: number, string, bool, annotation, wsi, pixelmap or class

outputEntry.title: Output entry
outputEntry.description: One output. Holds the common fields and exactly one kind block. Which kind block is allowed is decided by the EAD type of this key. For a `collection` output the entry describes the items of the collection.

label.description: Name shown to the user instead of the `io` key.

outputEntry.x-oneOfMessage: must contain exactly one kind block: pixelmap, wsi, number, string, bool or annotation

outputDefault.title: Output type default
outputDefault.description: Exactly one kind block, without `label` or `description`.
outputDefault.x-oneOfMessage: must contain exactly one kind block: pixelmap, wsi, number, string, bool or annotation

numberInput.title: number (input)
numberInput.description: A numeric job parameter. For an EAD `integer` the value must be a whole number.

value.description: Default value. Must lie within `min` and `max`.

prompt.description: `true`: the field is shown in the form, prefilled with `value`, and the user confirms before the job runs. `false`: the field is hidden and `value` is sent as is; `value` is then required.

unit.description: Unit shown next to the field, for example `µm` or `%`.

value.description: Default value. With `options` it must be one of them.

prompt.description: `true`: the field is shown in the form, prefilled with `value`, and the user confirms before the job runs. `false`: the field is hidden and `value` is sent as is; `value` is then required.

options.description: Closed list of accepted values. The field becomes a select.

label.description: Text shown to the user. Defaults to `value`.

max_length.description: Longest accepted text. The viewer never accepts more than 200 characters.

multiline.description: Show a multi-line text area instead of a one-line field.

prompt.description: `true`: the field is shown in the form, prefilled with `value`, and the user confirms before the job runs. `false`: the field is hidden and `value` is sent as is; `value` is then required.

annotationInput.title: annotation (input)
annotationInput.description: A region the user draws as job input. Its colour and class names come from the EAD.

keep_visible.description: `true`: the region stays on the slide after the job is submitted. `false`: it is hidden once the job is submitted.

render.description: `background`: the slide is the background when the job is opened for viewing. `none`: it is not shown.

pixelmapInput.title: pixelmap (input)
pixelmapInput.description: A pixel map chosen as job input. No settings yet; use it to give the input a `label`.

classInput.title: class (input)
classInput.description: A class chosen as job input. No settings yet; use it to give the input a `label`.

type.description: xOpat shader id, for example `heatmap`, `colormap` or `identity`.

params.description: Parameters of that shader, as xOpat defines them.

pixelmapOutput.title: pixelmap (output)
pixelmapOutput.description: A pixel map result drawn over the slide. Class colours of a nominal pixel map come from the EAD.

render.description: `shader`: draw the map as an overlay. `none`: never show it.

visible.description: Whether the overlay is switched on when it is first shown.

shader.description: Shader used for the overlay. Replaces the viewer's default as a whole.

wsiOutput.title: wsi (output)
wsiOutput.description: A slide-like result: an EAD `wsi` output, or a `string` output with a `reference` whose value is the id of a registered mask slide.

render.description: `shader`: draw it as an overlay. `background`: offer it as a background. `none`: never show it.

visible.description: Whether the overlay is switched on when it is first shown.

shader.description: Shader used for the overlay. Replaces the viewer's default as a whole.

render.description: `metric`: list the value among the job's results and offer it for sorting. `none`: hide it.
`metric`: list the value among the job's results. `none`: hide it.
`metric`: list the value among the job's results. `none`: hide it.

annotationOutput.title: annotation (output)
annotationOutput.description: Annotations produced by the job. Reserved: the block is accepted so the output can carry a `label`, but it has no settings yet and the viewer reports it as not supported.
